Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title 'Fix admission form submit hanging/timing out on production' --category Fix --description 'submitOnlineAdmission\(\) awaits sendOnlineAdmissionSubmissionEmail\(\) synchronously in the critical submit path \(result already ignored on failure via try/catch\).
